movement_profile.footwork: Utilizes jazz shoes or foot thongs for traction and cushioning on hard surfaces.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo, pair, or group formations; requires fluid transitions across the performance space.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes various tricks of varying complexity; requires strength, flexibility, and balance.
movement_profile.partnering: Includes lifts, adagio, and partner tricks like the pitch tuck.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and form-fitting; body lines are emphasized.

signature_moves.description: One dancer forms a saddle with hands to propel a partner upward for a rotation.
signature_moves.name: Pitch tuck

signature_moves.description: A group trick involving multiple dancers forming a pyramid structure.
signature_moves.name: Bridge pyramid

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Loose clothing that does not move synchronously with the body; performing on surfaces without proper traction or cushioning.

teaching.level_notes: Requires training in both dance technique and acrobatic skills.
